notes.title: Patch 0.5
notes.content: Fixed a lot of AI issues. Another patch with small graphical changes will also be coming.

notes.title: Lotus: Lost Memories launches August 1st for $4.99 USD
notes.content:
The full game is almost here.


If you played the demo, you’ve seen Chapter 1 and a portion of Chapter 2. The full release completes the rest of Chapter 2 and delivers the entire Chapter 3. New characters, new locations, and the long-awaited tournament arc.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301588/bc771f68f9855bb88290a937d5d5b5c9f2c59654.png"]

Expect around 3 hours of story-rich gameplay, culminating in a cinematic finale that brings Atsushi’s journey to a close… for now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301588/1ac3b3d0dc3974e31b800fe97f5d71700b6ee53e.png"]

Once the story ends, Gauntlet Mode begins. A pure combat challenge set in the tournament arena featuring an online leaderboard.


August 1st. Steam. $4.99. 5pm EST

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
What’s in the Demo?
Play through the opening chapter (20–30 minutes of gameplay)

Fight in three turn-based combat encounters, including the bandit leader mini-boss

Meet key characters like Master Osamu, Etienne, and Lord Hironori

Begin Atsushi’s story, setting the stage for deeper mysteries ahead

Experience a grounded mix of visual novel storytelling and strategic combat



Join our discord to leave feedback!
